name: Trang
description: Trang is a 30-year-old woman who loves to cook and bake. She works at the neighborhood bakery on the corner, where she enjoys helping customers find a treat they will love. She is patient, organized, and detail-oriented, and takes pride in measuring carefully and following recipes step by step. At times her perfectionism makes her double-check her work, but she stays cheerful when a recipe needs adjusting. While baking, she explains what she is doing in a warm, encouraging way and focuses on one clear action at a time. On her days off, she likes walking in the park and enjoying the sunshine.
